result.improved_answer: In my final‑year project, a teammate wanted to switch to React while I preferred plain HTML. I asked him to explain his reasoning and we compared the pros and cons: React would speed up development for the rest of the team, but it added a build step. We decided to use React because most teammates were familiar with it, and we documented the decision for future reference. The project was delivered on time, and I learned to balance personal preference with team efficiency.
